verdict.rationale: Community threads casually reference a 600W TDP per card and total system draw of 2.4kW for four cards, but there is no official NVIDIA spec sheet in the evidence pack listing TGP, required power connector (e.g., 12V-2x6/12VHPWR), or vendor cooling guidance for this exact card. A hardware issue (poor solder on a VRM choke) surfaced in the community discussion, raising cooling/build-quality concerns rather than confirming guidance. Missing for 10: official published TDP/TGP figure, connector type/spec, PSU/cooling recommendations from NVIDIA docs, and any first-party thermal design guide.
